transcript:
Meeting header:
Date: 2026-04-21
Start time: 15:00 UTC
Duration: ~60 minutes
Attendees: Priya Nair, Alex Chen, Miguel Santos, Hannah Li, Samir Patel, Jenna Torres, Carlos Vega, Allan Moore
Links shared: https://redwood.internal/docs/soc2-evidence (SOC2 evidence map), https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kms-rotation (KMS runbook)

Summary: quick retrospective of last week's billing blip, status on SOC2 artifacts, KMS rotation plan, schedule for restore drill, and follow-ups on cost allocation tagging. Mostly internal coordination; some transcript noise.

Topics: billing anomaly, KMS rotation, backup restore drill, SOC2 evidence, tagging and accruals, facility maintenance window

Action items (recorded in notes): see metadata section

Transcript:
[00:00] Priya Nair: Okay, thanks everyone for joining. Uh we'll keep this to an hour. Quick round robin — are there any blockers we should call out up front?
[00:18] Alex Chen: I can start — two things, billing blip follow-up and the KMS rotation dry run scheduling. I also have a small FYI about the jumpbox patching window.
[00:30] Miguel Santos: SOC2 items for me, I have a list of outstanding evidence, I think two controls still need screenshots from infra. I'll get to that.
[00:38] Hannah Li: Jumpbox is related — we need a maintenance window and Facilities needs lead time for physical access to the colo cage. Allan, can you confirm availability?
[00:45] Allan Moore: Yeah I can do next Thursday afternoon, but we might need to get the escorts sorted early.
[00:52] Priya Nair: Great. Samir, finance on the dedicated capacity accruals?
[00:56] Samir Patel: I'm halfway through. There's an extra charge from last month that didn't have a matching tag, so I've queued a ticket to Procurement (Carlos is on it) to request the invoice detail. If Procurement can't get it, we might amortize across teams for this quarter.
[01:12] Carlos Vega: Yup I've back-chatted the vendor, expecting a CSV export. If not, we'll push for a credit.
[01:20] Priya Nair: Okay, itemized next steps then. Alex: can you run the KMS rotation dry run and share playbook?
[01:27] Alex Chen: Yep — plan is to do a non-prod dry run first, confirm H S M rotation, then prod with staged keys. I'll write a postmortem template in case something goes sideways.
[01:38] Miguel Santos: Quick note — for SOC2 the KMS rotation evidence needs the key rotation logs; make sure CloudTrail retention is set long enough. I noticed a retention policy that looks short on one account — might be the cause of missing artifacts.
[01:52] Hannah Li: Which account? Is this the east-prod account?
[01:56] Miguel Santos: I think so, but the transcription on some of the alerts is garbled in the ticket — it says "east pod" but I mean east-prod.
[02:07] Priya Nair: All right, let's flag that as an action. Samir, about the untagged charge — if Procurement can't get CSV we'll put it in misc. charge bucket and we will amortize. We need a note to execs explaining reason and impact.
[02:21] Samir Patel: I'll draft the note. Priya, you'll review?
[02:25] Priya Nair: Yup.
[02:28] Alex Chen: On the jumpbox, one more caveat — the patching will cause about 10‑minute downtime for SSH sessions. Can we schedule during low-traffic window?
[02:38] Miguel Santos: We should also rotate the bastion host keys as part of that maintenance. Might as well do both.
[02:44] Hannah Li: Agreed. If Facilities can do escorts on Thursday, I'll greenlight. Allan, any constraints on Thursday?
[02:50] Allan Moore: Thursday afternoon 14:00-18:00 is possible; prefer 15:00 start to give staff time.
[02:57] Priya Nair: Let's tentatively book 15:00 Thursday for jumpbox + bastion rotation, Hannah to confirm.
[03:03] Hannah Li: I'll confirm and update the runbook link.
[03:08] Priya Nair: On the SOC2 evidence — Miguel can you walk us through the evidence map and missing bits?
[03:15] Miguel Santos: Sure. I uploaded the map to the drive, link in the header. Controls AC-6 and CH-5 (intent: account provisioning and config change logs) are the ones missing screenshots and a couple of attestation forms. The retention gap I mentioned affects CH-5.
[03:30] Priya Nair: Can we get screenshots from infra by Friday?
[03:33] Hannah Li: Should be doable — I just need to know exact timestamps and accounts. Miguel, can you annotate the map with exact log ranges?
[03:40] Miguel Santos: I'll add annotations today. Some logs are across multiple regions, so expect ambiguity in the first pass.
[03:46] Priya Nair: Great. Next, backup restore drill — we planned for an end-of-month drill, right?
[03:52] Alex Chen: Yeah, target week of May 4th. I want to run a full restore from snapshot to staging and run the smoke tests. We should include a short TTL for secrets and make sure K-V cash — I mean KV cache warmup is part of the checklist. (laughs)
[04:10] Miguel Santos: "K-V cash" — classic transcription bug. But yes, warmup and stateful caches need to be covered, plus any rehydration scripts.
[04:18] Priya Nair: Who will own the post-drill report?
[04:21] Alex Chen: I'll own the drill and report; Hannah will own infra notes, Miguel will handle control evidence for any gaps.
[04:29] Priya Nair: OK, Alex owns drill report. Samir I need an updated estimate of cost exposure if we need to spin additional dedicated GPUs for a P0 incident — just ballpark.
[04:40] Samir Patel: I'll put together a quick spreadsheet — it's mostly linear but there's a delta for burst capacity. I'll send by Monday.
[04:47] Priya Nair: We got a misc billing blip last month — any more details?
[04:51] Carlos Vega: Vendor supplied an invoice with a vendor line item mismatch; it's likely a mis-allocated reserved instance credit. I'm following up.
[04:58] Miguel Santos: Slightly different topic — SSO recent flaps. We saw Okta auth timeouts earlier today for some internal tools. Has anyone tracked root cause?
[05:08] Alex Chen: There was a spike in rate-limits between our edge and Okta during an automated job. We patched the job to batch auth requests and it stabilized. I'll add a circuit-breaker on the job.
[05:20] Priya Nair: Any legal items? Jenna?
[05:22] Jenna Torres: Short one — procurement asked if we can add a clause to new vendor agreements to require machine-readable invoices (CSV/JSON) so finance can ingest automatically. Carlos is on that.
[05:34] Carlos Vega: Yep, adding the invoice format requirement to the template.
[05:37] Priya Nair: Perfect. Anything else on tagging? We've seen drift in service tags so cost allocation is messy.
[05:44] Samir Patel: Two missing tags pop up a lot: "owner_team" and "cost_center". I'm proposing a nightly lambda to detect untagged resources and open a ticket automatically with the owner_email field from the cloud resource metadata. It's not perfect but will catch 80% of drift.
[06:00] Hannah Li: We should make sure the lambda doesn't itself incur runaway costs — maybe run sampling first.
[06:05] Alex Chen: Agree. Also need to ensure the lambda's credentials are scoped. Miguel please review policy.
[06:10] Miguel Santos: Will review IAM scope. Also recommend a read-only role for lambda to avoid escalation risks.
[06:15] Priya Nair: Good. We also have the AO outage readout from last week — any follow ups from that?
[06:21] Alex Chen: Main cause was a flaky autoscaling policy tied to a custom metric; fixed the metric ingestion pipeline and we've seen no regressions. I'll keep the alert at low severity for another week then de-escalate.
[06:34] Priya Nair: Anything else before we do a quick recap?
[06:37] Miguel Santos: One small ask — when Alex runs the KMS rotation dry run, can he snapshot CloudTrail logs and preserve them as evidence for rotation? I want an immutable copy.
[06:46] Alex Chen: Yep, I'll put an archive step into the runbook and push to the SOC2 folder.
[06:51] Priya Nair: Okay quick recap and owners: Alex — KMS rotation dry run + runbook (due 04/28), Hannah — confirm jumpbox window and reserve facility escort (due 05/03), Miguel — annotate evidence map and upload missing screenshots (due 04/30), Samir — finalize accruals and send bucket (due 04/26), Priya — draft exec note for misc charge (due 04/23). Any objections?
[07:12] (brief crosstalk)
[07:16] Allan Moore: No objections.
[07:18] Priya Nair: Great — we'll reconvene next Wednesday same time. Closing notes: be sure to mark tickets with the tag "ops-weekly-retro" so we can track follow-through.
[07:30] Alex Chen: Will do.
[07:33] Priya Nair: Thanks everyone.
[07:36] (meeting ends)

Notes about transcription quality: medium — occasional mis-hearings (e.g., "K-V cash" instead of "KV cache", "east pod" instead of "east-prod"). Some speaker labels merged. Document links and runbook references included above.
